cases.subject: Recording failures on same-account (on-net) calls
cases.summary: Customer reports recordings fail intermittently when calling between numbers on the same Telnyx account. Root cause: on-net (same-account) calls are handled as a single B2BUA session with only an inbound leg — no outbound PSTN leg is created. Recording CDRs DO exist on the inbound leg (completed: 1, record_completion_cause: success-silence) but no second recording exists because there's no second call. Compared to working off-net call which has 7 CDR legs and 2 recording CDRs. Analysis complete, awaiting Sean's review before drafting customer response. Possible product gap — may need escalation to voice engineering.
